=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:562-566 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The terminal same-head gate checks `[ "${EVENT_NAME}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]`, but `review_autofix.yml` is invoked through `workflow_call`, so the condition is false on the sweep-dispatched path it is intended to suppress.
  WHY: `github.event_name` resolves to `workflow_call` inside the reusable workflow, leaving terminal same-head PRs eligible for repeated codex-agent runs; all reviewers agree on the defect and severity.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:605-610, ~666-669 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The embedded parser catches JSON `ValueError`, converts malformed input to an empty marker list, and exits successfully, making the documented `reason=parse_error` log branch unreachable.
  WHY: Malformed `PARTIAL_MARKER_COMMENTS_JSON` is silently reported as `terminal=false matching_markers=0` rather than emitting `AUTOFIX_GATE_TERMINAL_SAME_HEAD_QUERY_FAILED`; all reviewers agree, with confidence 5.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:594, ~639-641 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The marker author filter compares against `AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN` defaulting to `codex`, while the workflow-posted marker is authored by the `GH_PAT` owner, causing legitimate markers to be rejected.
  WHY: `AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN` represents commit identity but is reused for comment identity, so `matching_markers=0` prevents the terminal same-head skip on default-configured repositories; severity differs across reviewers, so the highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:661-672, ~670-672 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Markers rejected by the author filter produce `matching_markers=0` and no diagnostic log, making rejected markers indistinguishable from absent markers.
  WHY: Operators cannot determine whether no marker exists or an identity mismatch filtered it out, masking the marker-author defect.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 562-563, guard condition `[ "${EVENT_NAME}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]` with `EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}` set at line 266, in a workflow whose sole trigger at line 4 is `workflow_call`
  PROBLEM: The terminal same-head skip condition checks for `workflow_dispatch` events, but `review_autofix.yml` has no `workflow_dispatch` trigger.
  WHY: Every real dispatch path resolves to `workflow_call` inside `review_autofix.yml`, so the guard never runs and terminal same-head PRs continue consuming runner time and LLM spend.
  severity=critical | confidence=5
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 605-608 (Python heredoc `json.loads` catch of `ValueError`) and 656-658 (shell `if [ -z "${terminal_decision}" ]; then echo "AUTOFIX_GATE_TERMINAL_SAME_HEAD_QUERY_FAILED ... reason=parse_error"`)
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python parser catches `json.loads` `ValueError`, converts `PARTIAL_MARKER_COMMENTS_JSON` to an empty list, prints `terminal=false matching_markers=0`, and exits 0.
  WHY: The documented `reason=parse_error` branch is unreachable for malformed JSON, so parser corruption is silently treated as no matching markers.
  severity=high | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The sweep cron must dispatch the terminal-same-head guard with the caller's dispatch-vs-PR origin so the guard can distinguish cron-triggered `workflow_call` events from manual `workflow_dispatch` events. Per the PR description: "The sweep cron still re-dispatched every open PR every 30 minutes... after PR #4077 went terminal on 0d30bc69 the sweep dispatched about 25 more same-head runs over 12.5 hours."
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` within the terminal-same-head block (around lines 562-563), or the reusable workflow inputs (`internal-review.yml` forwarding the caller event origin)
  Evidence of absence: The guard condition on line 563 checks `[ "${EVENT_NAME}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]` where `EVENT_NAME` is `${{ github.event_name }}` (line 266). Since `review_autofix.yml` only has a `workflow_call` trigger (line 4), `github.event_name` is always `workflow_call` for sweep-dispatched runs through `internal-review.yml`. No input carries the original dispatch event name from the intermediate workflow. Neither the ORIGINAL PR DIFF nor LAST RUN DIFF introduces a mechanism to distinguish sweep callers from non-sweep callers under `workflow_call`.
  confidence=5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Parser failures must be logged with the documented `AUTOFIX_GATE_TERMINAL_SAME_HEAD_QUERY_FAILED ... reason=parse_error` line so the pipeline continues normally. Per the PR description: "A comments API failure or an unparseable marker logs `AUTOFIX_GATE_TERMINAL_SAME_HEAD_QUERY_FAILED` and runs normally."
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` around lines 605-608 (Python heredoc) or lines 656-658 (shell parse-error branch)
  Evidence of absence: The Python parser at lines 605-608 catches `ValueError` from `json.loads` and converts to `comments = []`, then prints `terminal=false matching_markers=0` and exits 0. The shell's `if [ -z "${terminal_decision}" ]` branch is unreachable for JSON parse errors because the subshell always exits 0. Neither the ORIGINAL PR DIFF nor LAST RUN DIFF introduces a path where JSON parse errors reach `reason=parse_error`. The matching test `test_parser_fails_open_on_garbage_input` asserts `terminal=false` and `matching_markers=0` on invalid JSON, explicitly locking in the silent path.
  confidence=5
